raw_frame_controls: native-resolution decoding; fixed first-frame vascular mask; brightness normalized to first-frame median; translation estimated per-recording at 64x64 and applied to native grayscale; complement-mask control is outside estimated vessel mask, not known nonvascular tissue
primary_analysis: 120 unique source recordings after exact AVI and event-content deduplication (89 MCAO, 31 healthy); keep all 128 identities in audit/crosswalk; no offline augmented test copies
cohort_correction: 8 identical AVI/event pairs all cross legacy outer folds; rebuild shared nested source-family splits before training; do not reuse leaked historical scores as new independent-animal benchmarks
primary_seed_summary: average held-out seed probabilities per animal with averaged training-selected fold thresholds; also report every seed separately
selection_rule: inner balanced accuracy; no architecture selection using outer-test results
decision_rule: Report all prespecified comparisons including negative findings. Evidence of gain requires paired animal-bootstrap CI excluding zero for the named metric; no automated journal-readiness or acceptance certification.
completion_rule: Finish the finite prespecified queue, verify manifests and prediction lineage, and report passed, inconclusive or failed comparisons. Do not keep changing models or resampling until a positive outer-test result appears.
